'''Senar''' was an [[Ogier]].

==History==
He is known as the father of [[Malan]] and the grandfather of [[Aran]], but nothing about his own life is known.

Given that his grandson was born in {{ab|50}}, Senar was born in either the [[Age of Legends]] or during the [[Breaking of the World]].{{ref/book|bwb}}
